title.zh: Microsoft AI Chief Mustafa Suleyman Says Most Professional Tasks Will Be Fully Automated By AI Within 12

body.en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman predicted most professional tasks will be fully automated by AI within about a year.
body.zh: 微软AI负责人Mustafa Suleyman预测，未来约一年内大多数专业性工作将被AI完全自动化。

title.en: Mustafa Suleyman sets out Microsoft AI's goal of 'humanist superintelligence'
title.zh: Mustafa Suleyman sets out Microsoft AI's goal of 'humanist superintelligence'

body.en: Mustafa Suleyman laid out Microsoft AI's mission of building 'humanist superintelligence.'
body.zh: 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼阐述了微软AI打造「人本超级智能」的使命目标。
